test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 25 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following was the first BCCI president?
solution:
The correct answer is__** RE Grant Govan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **RE Grant Govan:-**

 
 
• He was a businessman and the managing director of the Govan Bros. Ltd, a leading business house at that time.
 
• He was also a keen cricketer and played for the Bombay Gymkhana Cricket Club.
 
• **He was the first BCCI president.**
 
• **He was elected president in 1928, when the BCCI was founded. He held the position till 1933.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Anthony Stanislaus de Mello:-**

 
 
• **He was an Indian cricket administrator and one of the founders of the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI). **
 
• He also helped launch the Asian Games as the chairman of the organising committee for the first Asian Games in Delhi.
 
 
 
• **Roger Michael Humphrey Binny:-**
 
 
• **He is a former Indian international cricketer and the 36th and incumbent president of the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI). **
 
• He is the first player from Karnataka to be elected as BCCI president.
 
 
 
• **JC Mukherjee:-**
 
 
• **He was a Bengali cricketer who played for East Bengal Club in the Calcutta Cricket League in the early 20th century. **
 
• He was a right-handed batsman and a right-arm medium pace bowler.
